caption: The video captures a Hong Kong Air Cargo twin-engine jet, registration B-LNV, in red, white and yellow livery, flying against a clear blue sky with faint cloud wisps. The red titles and small logo remain visible along the upper fuselage. The aircraft holds a nose-up, gently banked attitude exposing its grey underside, with the nose gear and main gear extended and remaining down throughout. Over the clip the framing changes steadily, as the vertical tail fin, first cropped at the left edge, gradually comes into view to reveal its yellow swirl emblem. Meanwhile the wing, engine nacelle and main gear slide rightward within the frame while the nose stays pointed upper right. The pitch, roll and gear configuration stay essentially constant, with no retraction or major attitude change visible. With the open sky offering no fixed reference, the aircraft appears to continue a climb or approach.
relations: The camera framing shifts rightward, gradually bringing the previously cropped vertical tail fin into full view.
As the tail fin enters the frame, its yellow swirl emblem becomes visible against the blue sky.
The wing, engine nacelle, and main gear slide rightward within the frame while the nose remains pointed upper right.
The aircraft's pitch, roll, and extended landing gear configuration remain constant throughout the camera movement.
